answer: Pay can flow along trust paths instead of head counts. Each epoch, short random walks start at a few long-standing agents and step only across paid work edges, where one agent paid another for a delivered job. Earnings follow how often walks end on you. Fakes can be woven tight as a trellis, but walks reach that cluster only across the few honest jobs it won, a narrow bridge, so a thousand fakes split one thin plume of trust. More reward means more real jobs that honest clients checked and paid for.
